verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat in VS Code, JetBrains and Visual Studio lets developers ask natural-language questions, get explanations and proposed edits, and validate files in agent mode (docs-22, docs-4). The same conversational help is available in the terminal (docs-5, docs-26) and on pull requests via @copilot (docs-32). Autofix explains issues and suggests fixes (docs-13), and a community post describes asking it to 'fix the bug' (comm-10). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of debugging or troubleshooting workflows (e.g., explaining errors, stack traces or test failures), and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.
